why: Across the nine Phase V plan-gate runs, the relevance question was the low-confidence role in most failing cells. Scopes name Phase U sprints (u-6/u-9, u-8/u-9, 'closing fuzz sprint of Phase U') or carry the stale 'opt-in' wording, which Phase V items never use. Per question-tuning.md, first rewrite scope as item-level signals, then tune `relevant` only if still needed. Statements are unchanged.

groups.scope: An item that implements, changes, documents, tests or verifies the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach) or the sc-composer-beads library in advanced pour, the default mode (`--render-by sc-compose`) in which sc-compose renders every loop, condition, include and variable expression before bd runs.
An item that implements, changes, tests or verifies how sc-composer-beads or the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, attach) substitute variables into a template.

An item that implements, changes, tests or verifies bd-owned mode (`--render-by bd`) of the sc-compose bead commands (pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach) or sc-composer-beads, in which sc-compose leaves `{{ }}` expressions for bd to render, as sc-compose v1.7.0 does.
An item that implements, changes, tests or verifies how the sc-compose bead commands or sc-composer-beads create beads, including what happens when rendering or validation fails.
An item that adds, changes, runs or wires into CI the byte-regression check comparing schema-less template output with sc-compose v1.7.0, its golden files, or its approved-exceptions list.
An item that implements, changes or tests the sc-compose graph-plan command or how it writes its output path.
An item that implements, changes or tests the undeclared-variable check or strict validation in sc-composer or the sc-compose CLI.
An item that ports, recovers, reuses or reimplements sc-composer-beads code or its tests, including from the rebuild/from-main branch.
An item that maps, reruns or verifies the earlier fuzz regression cases (FUZZ-171-01..14, T-02..T-06, D-01, include-default #11) against a release candidate.
An item that runs or verifies the 229-template corpus check against a release candidate.
An item that adds, changes or wires the tool that generates sc-compose command-line documentation.
An item that adds or changes the sc-compose publish workflow, release preparation, or the preflight it runs before publishing.
An item that adds or changes sc-compose release preflight configuration or the checks release preflight runs.

An item that adds or changes CI workflows, integration tests or release preflight runs that build or install sc-compose artifacts across platforms, Python versions, or pip/uv. Rand approved clarification YES via relay ATM01M6JJ70WRQYV1KCEDZZK6WGJW: full matrix includes all supported artifact/platform cells plus wheel Python-version and pip/uv install combinations; restricted to integration tests required by preflight, excluded from normal sprint continuous integration.
An item that adds or changes the sc-compose spelling lint check, its allowlist (.codespellignore), or the lint gate that runs it.
An item that adds or changes sc-compose CI workflows or the integration-test workflow, including which jobs run on Windows amd64 or manylinux.

An item that adds, changes or verifies the build of any sc-compose release artifact family (Rust CLI archive, sc-compose wheel, sc-sha wheel, sc-composer-beads wheel, sc-sha-go native module) for any of the six OS/architecture targets.
